mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 55 degrees with clear skies at Reddan Soccer Park and a waxing gibbous moon.

City officials announced that fall leaf collection starts October 5, requiring residents to keep leaves off the street, while the Plan Commission meets the same day to review various local development projects.
Today you can enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness or Hop Haus trivia, followed by a busy tomorrow featuring live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee plus the start of the Verona Fall Fest.
On September 3, a 33-year-old Madison man was arrested for an O W I second offence following a vehicle crash in the 700 block of Shooting Star Road.
The local Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and check out the flavor of the day.
